author: reek
body: The CL 2710 regression pin. A callee whose RETURN TYPE transitively mentions the mutable record only through a record-field chain that crosses a List boundary is a borrow - it reads the state without handing it on. Recursing into sum/list payloads when walking record FIELDS (tried CL 2710) makes this a consume and rejects legitimate read-twice code; the field walk must stay sum/list-blind.
